description: Unrecognized marker string, or a cond= that could not be parsed (see the bridge stderr; add it to the codebook in lsl_bridge.py). Never 0: the .easy trigger column is 0 when no marker is present, so a 0 code would be indistinguishable from 'nothing happened'.
Auditory stimulus onset during the reaction-time phase. Reaction time is measured from here.
Spacebar pressed within the 2 s response window. The RT in ms is in the behavioural CSV, not the code.
Spacebar pressed before the tone (anticipation). Resets the stimulus timer.
No press within the 2 s response window (a miss).
Session begins (stimulation starts) — heating control condition.
Session begins — 850 nm NIR pulsed at 10 Hz.
Session begins — 850 nm NIR pulsed at 40 Hz.
Session ends (stimulation stops) — heating control condition.
Session ends — 10 Hz NIR.
Session ends — 40 Hz NIR.
10-min silent EMG-baseline phase begins (no tones/clicks; stimulation is on).
EMG phase ends.
7-min reaction-time phase begins (tones + responses).
Reaction-time phase ends.
Session frozen by a thermal shutdown (skin temp exceeded 40 C); paired with SAFETY_TRIP.
Session resumed after the temperature recovered to <=37.5 C (stimulation restarted).
Scheduled mid-phase cooling break begins (stimulation off). Planned pacing, NOT a safety event — each real-session phase is split at its midpoint by a 1.5-min break.
Scheduled cooling break over; stimulation back on and the phase second half resumes.
Stimulation-off post gap begins — the last step of every condition (RT_END precedes it, SESSION_END follows). 1.5 min.
Post gap over; SESSION_END follows.
Device stimulation block ended or aborted (NIR/heater off).
NIR light physically ON — 850 nm pulsed at 10 Hz, 50% duty.
NIR light physically ON — 850 nm pulsed at 40 Hz, 50% duty.
Heater element energised (heating-control condition; PID-regulated).
Heater element off.
40 C skin-temperature safety cutoff latched — all stimulation force-stopped.
